name: Paradise Arena
source:
A man named Shin'ichi encounters a mysterious young girl who tells him that she and her friends developed new technology that allows unprecedented immersion in virtual worlds. Shin'ichi is then chosen to be the test subject of the new virtual reality device, participating in adventures where his sexual powers are tested above all.

[edited from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/paradise-arena]MobyGames[/url]]
